_comment: ARC Atlanta 2020 AM network (Cube-style, already directed A->B). This config declares the PROHIBIT access-code table as a reusable access_code_map preset so an agency DECLARES codes instead of writing Python. Capacity/VDF are ARC-specific (modified-BPR by FACTYPE) and are set by arc_atlanta_to_gmns.py; this config is exercised specifically to re-derive the allowed_use + toll_flag access columns and byte-compare them to the reference gmns/link.csv.
